title: Function Over Title
note: Bohdan's day on the east curtain. Two corbel braces set under load (nat 18, nat 13 — both succeed). Crew above the second brace would have died; did not. Afternoon walk-through identifies 9 corbels for attention, 3 immediate, 1 morning-critical. Daiva sets a brace under his eye and gets it right. At supper Mnehmos confirms function-over-title — Bohdan's word cuts crews loose on sight when a wall is ready to slip. After supper, alone, he finally reads Tomáš's beer-note and makes the pencil dot beside YES. Deferred personal reckoning paid off-public-ledger.
